prompts.title: Welcome to Stranger Things
prompts.prompt:
Create a realistic high-quality photo using the reference face without changes. Inspired by Stranger Things, capturing the dark, mysterious Upside Down.
Main Subject: Young, slim girl with expressive eyes, tense but determined expression, long wavy hair flowing dynamically. Standing in a three-quarter turn, looking over her shoulder. White fitted T-shirt and short denim shorts. Warm red light casts sharp shadows.
Background: Dark green rectangular “WELCOME TO HAWKINS” sign on two posts, worn look, grass at base. Sky dominates: crimson, orange, dark red clouds, internally lit, bright central lightning.
Monster / Threat: Massive black clawed/spider-like limbs descending from clouds, looming around the sign.
Details & Effects: Floating glowing particles (ash, spores, sparks). Cinematic contrast: sign in shadow, background brightly lit.
Style & Technique: Horror/thriller, cinematic photorealism, sharp focus on the girl, shallow depth of field, slight film grain, camera from below for majestic sky view.
Photorealistic style: The image should be in a tall, vertical portrait format corresponding to a 4:5 aspect ratio.
